lines.text: The Fairbanks borough may soon draw a line around big data centers.
lines.t: The Fairbanks borough may soon draw a line around big data centers.

lines.text: Mayor Grier Hopkins proposed pausing their permits for twelve months.
lines.t: Mayor Grier Hopkins proposed pausing their permits for twelve months.

lines.text: Then the Planning Commission recommended eighteen.
lines.t: Then the Planning Commission recommended eighteen.

lines.text: It isn't a vote on A I. The line is size and power.
lines.t: It isn't a vote on A I. The line is size and power.

lines.text: Per the News-Miner, any one of three things would trip it. At least five megawatts of power.
lines.t: Per the News-Miner, any one of three things would trip it. At least five megawatts of power.

lines.text: Or at least forty thousand square feet.
lines.t: Or at least forty thousand square feet.

lines.text: Or at least five megawatts made on site.
lines.t: Or at least five megawatts made on site.

lines.text: The planning director says five megawatts can power at least three thousand homes.
lines.t: The planning director says five megawatts can power at least three thousand homes.

lines.text: For context, the general use zone covers ninety seven percent of the borough.
lines.t: For context, the general use zone covers ninety seven percent of the borough.

lines.text: In the director's words, anything goes in general use.
lines.t: In the director's words, anything goes in general use.

lines.text: So the line is clear on size. Where it reaches is another question.
lines.t: So the line is clear on size. Where it reaches is another question.

lines.text: Follow it to Eielson Air Force Base. The borough likely can't zone inside that fence.
lines.t: Follow it to Eielson Air Force Base. The borough likely can't zone inside that fence.

lines.text: Hopkins believes a data center built purely for a government purpose wouldn't be subject to the pause.
lines.t: Hopkins believes a data center built purely for a government purpose wouldn't be subject to the pause.

lines.text: For private use, it might be different.
lines.t: For private use, it might be different.

lines.text: Hopkins says the borough is researching how to turn that gray area black and white.
lines.t: Hopkins says the borough is researching how to turn that gray area black and white.

lines.text: Now the test. Those asking for time have real reasons.
lines.t: Now the test. Those asking for time have real reasons.

lines.text: One commissioner warned that most of these come with diesel generators.
lines.t: One commissioner warned that most of these come with diesel generators.

lines.text: Another is hearing anxiety from people over A I in general.
lines.t: Another is hearing anxiety from people over A I in general.

lines.text: A resident told the commission it's smart to take the time.
lines.t: A resident told the commission it's smart to take the time.

lines.text: The opposite view is fair. Research would be due in ten months, but the pause would run eighteen.
lines.t: The opposite view is fair. Research would be due in ten months, but the pause would run eighteen.

lines.text: Nothing is law yet. The Assembly votes, likely January 14th, and the clock would start then.
lines.t: Nothing is law yet. The Assembly votes, likely January 14th, and the clock would start then.

lines.text: An eighteen month pause is readiness, not refusal, only if it ends with rules a builder can meet.
lines.t: An eighteen month pause is readiness, not refusal, only if it ends with rules a builder can meet.

lines.text: And an answer at the fence.
lines.t: And an answer at the fence.

lines.text: The line is clear on size. Now Fairbanks has to find out where it reaches.
lines.t: The line is clear on size. Now Fairbanks has to find out where it reaches.
